cards.name: KitchenAid Artisan 5-Quart Tilt-Head Stand Mixer
cards.badge: Kitchen · the clearest case for Cyber weekend

photo.credit: Photo: BenFrantzDale, CC BY-SA 2.0, Wikimedia Commons

cards.price: $349.99 at Target (regular $499.99) on Nov 16, 2026; $297.49 there with a 15% in-cart offer on Sunday, Nov 30, 2025 (Slickdeals). List $499.99.
cards.buy_if: you bake weekly and want the mixer that every attachment fits: $349.99 is already 30% off, and the Black Friday weekend has gone lower through stacked offers.
cards.skip_if: you only whip cream twice a year (a hand mixer does it), or you need a bigger bowl for heavy bread dough (look at a bowl-lift model).
cards.owners: Owners and repair shops say the nylon worm gear is the part that strips under heavy dough, by design, so the motor survives (Mr. Mixer); a Slickdeals owner said the tilt-head walks on the counter with stiff dough (July 2024).

buy.pick: The Artisan Series 5-quart tilt-head, model KSM150 (KSM150PS plus a colour code), not the 4.5-quart Classic or the 3.5-quart Artisan Mini
buy.check: The model number starts KSM150; sold by KitchenAid, Amazon.com or a big-box store; a sale on one colour only is normal, so pick the colour after the price
buy.label: See today's price

cards.name: Bissell Little Green (1400B)
cards.badge: Floor care · cheaper before the sale
cards.price: $129.99 at Bissell (Nov 16, 2026); Walmart about $110 (search snippet, Nov 2026) and $74.62 on Oct 7, 2026 (Slickdeals). Our line: under $90.
cards.buy_if: you clean pet accidents, kid spills and car seats: Walmart had it at $74.62 in October, so a Black Friday price under $90 is fine and $75 is as good as it has been.
cards.skip_if: you want to clean whole rooms of carpet (rent or buy an upright), or the deal is on a different model number (3369, 4064T, 2513W) you have not compared.
cards.owners: The common failure is a pump or nozzle that stops spraying, often from a clog (owner repair threads); fabric stays damp, so dry passes matter. See our full Little Green review.
cards.video_title: 6 years with the Bissell Little Green — a long-term review

buy.pick: The Little Green 1400B, not the Mini (3369 or 4064T) or the ProHeat (2513W), which are different machines
buy.check: The model reads 1400B; sold by Bissell, Amazon.com or a big-box store; under $90 is our line
buy.label: See today's price

cards.name: Dreame X50 Ultra
cards.badge: Robot vacuum · the maker's sale runs both days
cards.price: $999.99 at Dreame's store (list $1,599.99) and $1,199.99 at Target on Nov 16, 2026; the X50 Ultra Complete was $899.99 at Dreame the same day. Dreame ran it at $799.99 from Nov 20 to Dec 1, 2025.
cards.buy_if: you want a mopping robot that climbs low thresholds and can wait: last year's sale price was $200 below today's, and Dreame's sale covered Black Friday and Cyber Monday alike.
cards.skip_if: your home has many tall thresholds or rugs with fringe, or you would rather pay less for a refurbished unit (eBay listings went far lower after Cyber Monday 2025).
cards.owners: Owners on Galaxus and ProductReview reported dock and mop problems within weeks to months (undated reports); Vacuum Wars lists early navigation bugs and pads that fall off (Sept 2026).

cards.name: Instant Pot Duo 6-Quart 7-in-1
cards.badge: Kitchen · a Black Friday-week doorbuster, often earlier

photo.credit: Photo: Ajay Suresh, CC BY 2.0, Wikimedia Commons

cards.price: List $109.99 at Instant Pot (Oct 21, 2026); a 6-quart 9-in-1 bundle was $59.99 at Target on Nov 20, 2025, a week before Black Friday (Slickdeals).
cards.buy_if: you want one pot for beans, stock and rice and you can buy at $60–$80: that price has shown up in the week before Black Friday, not only on the day.
cards.skip_if: you mostly air-fry or want a quieter release (the Duo Plus or a Rio), or the sale price is above $80.
cards.owners: The common failures are a stretched or mis-seated sealing ring and a stuck float valve, both cheap to fix (owner troubleshooting guides); see our Instant Pot review for the full list.
cards.video_title: Instant Pot DUO 6QT Full Review & First Look
cards.video_why: A review of the exact 6-quart size; the title came from a search-result URL.

cards.name: Ninja AF101 4-Quart Air Fryer
cards.badge: Kitchen · small appliance, watch both days
cards.price: $89.99 at Best Buy, Save $30 from $119.99 (search snippet, Nov 2026); list $119.99. Target's page for it no longer loads.
cards.buy_if: you cook for one or two and want a simple basket fryer at under $80, a price Black Friday-week Ninja promotions have reached at Home Depot (32% off Ninja kitchen, 2025).
cards.skip_if: you cook for four (get a 6-quart or a dual basket), or you want a basket coating with a warranty: owner reports say the coating can flake, and wear parts may be excluded.
cards.owners: The recurring complaint in owner posts and guides is the basket coating flaking within months; the reports are thin and secondary, so we weigh them lightly.

cards.name: Whisker Litter-Robot 4
cards.badge: Pets · the robot barely moves; bundles do
cards.price: $699 at Whisker and Chewy on Nov 16, 2026 (Chewy from a search snippet); Whisker's holiday deal is $150 off bundles only. Costco had the LR4 + LitterHopper bundle at $699 on Dec 9, 2025, after Cyber Monday (Slickdeals).
cards.buy_if: you have two or more cats and want to stop scooping: buy when you need it, because neither Black Friday nor Cyber Monday moved the robot's own price in 2025 or so far in 2026.
cards.skip_if: you have one cat and a tight budget, or a kitten under 3 pounds (Whisker's sensor needs the weight).
cards.owners: Sensor faults are the dominant owner complaint (Slickdeals owner at about 8 months, replaced under warranty; RobotShop forum); owners with several cats call it worth the money.
cards.video_title: Litter-Robot 4: still the best after three years? (One Man Five Cats)
cards.video_channel: One Man Five Cats · long-term review
cards.video_why: Three years and five cats after buying it, a cat-tech channel asks whether the Litter-Robot 4 is still the one to buy — the long-term view most reviews can’t give, and the question to settle before spending $699.

cards.name: KONG Classic (natural rubber, made in the USA)

photo.credit: Photo: Olgierd, CC BY 2.0, Wikimedia Commons

cards.price: $13.99 at Target and PetSmart (Nov 16, 2026); $13.96 at Chewy (search snippet). A Black Friday 2025 cut from $13.99 to $11.96 was mocked on Slickdeals as trivial.
cards.buy_if: your dog needs something to chew this week: the price moves by about two dollars, so the right size matters more than the day.
cards.skip_if: your dog destroys rubber (the black Extreme exists for that), or you are buying it just because it is in a Black Friday banner.
cards.owners: Owners keep them for years and stuff them with frozen food to make them last; we found no common failure pattern in owner reports.
cards.video_title: 5 stuffed KONG recipes: how to stuff a KONG dog toy
cards.video_why: Five fillings, easy to hard. The stuffing is the product; an empty KONG is a red doorstop, and the freezer is where the twenty minutes come from.

cards.name: NOCO Boost Plus GB40 1000A Jump Starter
cards.chip: 1,000 A · 12 V · up to 6 L gas

photo.credit: Photo: Tony Webster, CC BY 2.0, Wikimedia Commons (earlier label)

cards.price: $99.95 list at NOCO, Home Depot and Walmart (search snippets, Nov 2026); NOCO's own site matched about $60 in late 2025, per a Slickdeals commenter, and Woot had it at $63.95 on Black Friday 2024.
cards.buy_if: you drive an older car or park outside in winter: deals near $60–$75 have come several times a year, so buy one when you see under $75, Black Friday or not.
cards.skip_if: you have a V8 truck or a diesel over 3 liters (the GB50 or GB70 is the safer size).
cards.owners: Owners report years of service; the failure stories involve a pack left uncharged in a car for two years (Expedition Portal), so top it up every few months.
cards.video_title: How to jump start using your NOCO Boost GB40
cards.video_why: The three-step jump-start routine, shown on a real car; the title came from a search-result URL.

cards.name: REDTIGER F7NP 4K Front and Rear Dash Cam
cards.badge: Car · the maker's store cut it before the sale
cards.price: $109.99 at REDTIGER's store without a card (crossed-out $129.99) on Nov 16, 2026; Walmart $129.99 with a 128GB card (search snippet). Refurbished units were $60.79 on REDTIGER's eBay store on Dec 23, 2025.
cards.buy_if: you want front and rear video for under $110 and do not mind a slow 2.4 GHz app: the maker's price already sits on our line.
cards.skip_if: you want a camera with frequent firmware updates and well-known support (owners on DashCamTalk and Team-BHP report thin support).
cards.owners: A handful of owners on Team-BHP and DashCamTalk report power cycling, GPS and won't-power-on failures, and few firmware updates.
cards.video_title: REDTIGER F7NP Dual Dash Cam Review & Driving Video
cards.video_why: A driving test of the exact F7NP; the title came from a search-result URL.

cards.name: Apple AirPods Pro 3
cards.badge: Earbuds · Cyber Monday is Adobe's day, but 2026 prices already beat last year's

photo.credit: Photo: Burkhard Mücke, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons

cards.price: $179.99 at Target (regular $249.99) on Nov 16, 2026; $199.99 at Best Buy (search snippet). The Black Friday 2025 low was $219.99, and it held through Cyber Monday (9to5Toys, Dec 10, 2025). Apple's store stays at $249.
cards.buy_if: you use an iPhone and want noise cancelling: $179.99 is $40 under last year's holiday low, so there is little reason to wait for a particular day.
cards.skip_if: you use Android (Sony or Pixel Buds fit better), or the buds already slip out of your ears (some owners report fit trouble in Apple's community).
cards.owners: MacRumors reported static or hiss with noise cancelling on and no audio for some owners (Oct 29, 2025), with Apple exchanging units; fit complaints appear in Apple Community threads.

buy.pick: AirPods Pro 3 (the 2025 model with heart-rate sensing), not AirPods Pro 2 or AirPods 4
buy.check: Sold by Amazon.com or Apple; the box says AirPods Pro 3; at or under $180 is our line
buy.label: See today's price

cards.name: Sony WF-1000XM6
cards.badge: Earbuds · first holiday season, expect the low on the big days
cards.price: $299.99 at Target and Best Buy (regular $329.99; Best Buy from a search snippet) on Nov 16, 2026. Sony's own store with an Amex offer came to $249.99 in April 2026 (Slickdeals).
cards.buy_if: you use Android and want the strongest noise cancelling in a small bud, at $280 or less: this is its first Black Friday, so Cyber Monday's electronics discounts are the likely low.
cards.skip_if: you use an iPhone (AirPods Pro 3 cost less and pair better), or foam tips do not stay in your ears.
cards.owners: Engadget's review and reports on Best Buy's page mention an unstable fit with the foam tips and a hinge that feels cheap; we could not open those Best Buy pages to confirm.
